definition: When acceleration is constant along a straight line, displacement, velocity, and time are related by kinematic equations.

worked_examples.problem_statement: A train starts from rest and accelerates at 2 m/s^2 for 10 s. Find final velocity and distance.

common_errors: Using equations when acceleration is not constant
real_world_hooks: Vande Bharat train leaving New Delhi station
IPL cricket ball rolling on a straight pitch
Delhi Metro picking up speed between two stations
visual_metaphor: A train speeding up on a straight track with glowing markers showing position every second
